headline: In the Kyrgyz Republic, development of the Markay coal deposit will begin. Investments have been attracted
summary: Investment has been attracted to develop the Markai coal deposit in Jalal-Abad region of Kyrgyzstan and expand its production capacity. Details of the investors were not given.
why: Coal is an energy commodity used for power generation and industry, so new deposit development affects regional energy supply and mining investment.
original_headline: В КР начнут осваивать угольное месторождение Маркай. Привлекли инвестиции
